LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_NemesisBloodline.label: (Raven) Phase Shift
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_NemesisBloodline.descriptio:
A spatial talent from the Nemesis bloodline. This unstable gene lets the bearer tear through space during long journeys.

Effects:
- When the movement target is farther than 30 cells, the bearer folds directly to the destination.
- Requires a 20-second cooldown to recharge after each fold.
- Automatically disabled while drafted to ensure tactical execution.
- Melee damage taken reduced by 10% (spatial refraction).
